content.value: A moving coil instrument gives a full scale deflection of 10 mA, when the potential difference across its terminal is 100 mV. Calculate:
(i) The shunt resistance for a full scale deflection corresponding to 100 mA.
(ii) Resistance for full scale reading with 1000 V.
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in answer script B)
